description: the extended encoding as written
c5a: group B keeps its occurrence status but loses its final occurrence claim (the claim and the link to it).
c5b: group C's occurrence status is changed to occurred while its final claim still says planned.
c6a: group E's identification status is changed to key_based while its final claim still says verified.
c7a: the export-side reference of group E loses its final resolution claim (the reified status and organisation statements and the links to them).
c7b: the export-side reference of group B is resolved to Vendor K (SYN) while its final claim still says Vendor Beta (SYN).
c8a: Vendor Beta (SYN) is asserted to have taken part in the planned group C (a bearer on its export-side participation node).
c8b: Vendor Beta (SYN) is asserted to have taken part in the merged group D (a bearer on its export-side participation node).
the extended encoding as written
c5a (NuProc). Group B keeps its occurrence status but loses its final occurrence claim.
c5b (NuProc). Group C's status is changed to occurred while its final claim still says planned.
c6a (NuProc). Group E's identification status is changed to key_based while its final claim still says verified.
c7a (NuProc). The export-side reference of group E loses its final resolution claim.
c7b (NuProc). The export-side reference of group B is resolved to Vendor K while its final claim still says Vendor Beta.
c8a (NuProc). Vendor Beta is asserted to have taken part in the planned group C: the cluster reports an engagement in which Vendor Beta participates.
c8b (NuProc). Vendor Beta is asserted to have taken part in the merged group D: the cluster reports an engagement in which Vendor Beta participates.
c1a (composition). The candidate-set reference of engagement A keeps one candidate only.
c1b (composition). The candidate-set reference of engagement A is marked resolved (its two candidates stay).
c2a (composition). The participation of engagement B carries a third role value that no final claim yielded.
c2b (composition). The earlier claim of human coder A (construction contract), which disagrees with the role values of the participation, is also marked final.
c3a (composition). The model coding v3 records both of its plans on one qualified association instead of one association per plan.
c3b (composition). The model coding v3 loses its prompt specification: only the codebook plan remains.

c4 (composition). In SEM a role and the participation are one node (a sem:Role constraint on sem:hasActor whose rdf:value is the bearer), so a bearer that does not participate can only be written by detaching that node from the engagement: the node keeps its bearer and its role types but no event has it as an actor.
